Players take turns placing disks on the board with their assigned color facing up. During a play, any disks of the opponent's color that are in a straight line and bounded by the disk just placed and another disk of the current player's color are turned over to the current player's color. The object of the game is to have the majority of disks turned to display your color when the last empty square is filled. It is essentially the same as Reversi. def negamax(board, depth, alpha, beta, player):
    if depth == 0 or is_terminal(board):
        return evaluation(board, player)  # difference for player
    moves = get_legal_moves(board, player)
    if not moves:
        # pass (no move)
        # Evaluate opponent's turn
        # Actually in Othello if player cannot move, the turn passes to opponent. So we just evaluate the opponent's perspective.
        # In minimax we can treat it as a move with no change, but with swapped player.
        return -negamax(board, depth-1, -beta, -alpha, 3-player)
    best = -inf
    # order moves: maybe prioritize corners, edges, etc.
    for move in moves:
        new_board = apply_move(board, player, move)
        score = -negamax(new_board, depth-1, -beta, -alpha, 3-player)
        best = max(best, score)
        alpha = max(alpha, score)
        if alpha >= beta:
            break
    return best

The evaluation: Weighted sum + mobility.

def evaluate(board, player):
    opp = 3 - player
    player_weight = sum(weights[r][c] for r in range(6) for c in range(6) if board[r][c]==player)
    opp_weight = sum(weights[r][c] for r in range(6) for c in range(6) if board[r][c]==opp)
    weight_diff = player_weight - opp_weight

    # piece count diff
    player_count = sum(1 for r in range(6) for c in range(6) if board[r][c]==player)
    opp_count = sum(1 for r in range(6) for c in range(6) if board[r][c]==opp)
    count_diff = player_count - opp_count

    # mobility diff
    player_moves = len(get_legal_moves(board, player))
    opp_moves = len(get_legal_moves(board, opp))
    mobility_diff = player_moves - opp_moves

    # combine:
    return weight_diff + count_diff*2 + mobility_diff*5
